comment: Rects are [x, y, width, height]. op is resolve or resolveAfterDrop around frames[fixed]. Checks: unchanged/moved (indices whose frame equals/differs from the input), noOverlaps (no pair intersects), inside (indices contained in bounds inset by 8), insideOrOriginal (every frame is inside the inset bounds or equals some input frame), disjoint (pairs that do not intersect), fieldEquals/fieldGreater (a frame field of an index).

cases.name: the dropped panel keeps its spot
panels that don't touch are left alone
the push is the shortest one available: right, not down
the push clears by exactly the gap
a panel pinned against the edge escapes the other way
three panels in a pile all end up apart
a window too small to separate them leaves them be
mid-drag the held panel never moves
after the drop the dropped panel may slide, and nothing overlaps
